issues.description: sample_rate cast to STTAudioFormat literal without validation against supported PCM rates
issues.detail: STTv2.__init__ builds audio_format via f'pcm_{sample_rate}' and casts to STTAudioFormat with no check. Unsupported rates (e.g. 11025, 32000) silently produce invalid format strings rejected only server-side with opaque errors. Validate sample_rate against {8000,16000,22050,24000,44100,48000} and raise ValueError early.

issues.description: APIConnectionError raised in _process_stream_event is swallowed by recv_task's broad except
issues.detail: _process_stream_event raises APIConnectionError on auth_error/quota_exceeded, but the call sits inside recv_task's blanket except Exception / log_exceptions wrapper that only logs and continues. Fatal errors never propagate; the stream stays stuck with a broken session. Re-raise these explicitly, narrow the except, or signal teardown via the event channel.

issues.description: Reconnect scaffolding is dead code; _reconnect_event is never set
issues.detail: The _run loop waits on self._reconnect_event to retry, but nothing in the class ever calls .set(). On transient ws failures, tasks_group surfaces the exception and the loop breaks instead of reconnecting, contradicting conn_options.max_retry expectations. Either wire actual reconnect-on-error semantics or remove the misleading machinery.

issues.description: Documented VAD parameter ranges are not enforced in __init__
issues.detail: Docstring states vad_silence_threshold_secs in [0.3,3.0], vad_threshold in [0.1,0.9], and min_speech/silence_duration_ms in [50,2000], but no bounds checks run. Out-of-range values are forwarded as query params, producing opaque remote errors. Add explicit validation matching the documented bounds so misuse fails fast locally.

issues.description: base_url scheme not validated; API key can leak over cleartext ws://
issues.detail: base_url is user-controllable and only str-replaced from https:// to wss://. A misconfigured http:// or scheme-less host silently sends the xi-api-key header over plaintext or fails opaquely. Validate that base_url uses https/wss, normalize trailing slashes, and reject or warn on non-TLS schemes.

issues.description: STTModels Literal has trailing comma and rejects forward-compatible model strings
issues.detail: STTModels = Literal['scribe_v2_realtime',] reads like a typo and, more substantively, blocks future model ids at type-check time. Drop the trailing comma for clarity and consider widening to str | STTModels to mirror other plugins' forward-compat pattern until more models exist.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a clean WebSocket STT v2 implementation following the established Deepgram/Cartesia pattern with several correctness gaps that should land before merge. Unanimous P0s: sample_rate is cast to a constrained Literal audio format without validation, and APIConnectionError raised in _process_stream_event is swallowed by recv_task's blanket exception handler so auth/quota errors never surface. Majority P1s: the reconnect_event machinery is scaffolded but never triggered, documented VAD/duration ranges go unenforced, and base_url scheme handling risks leaking the API key over cleartext. Style nit on the STTModels Literal rounds out the list. No tests, acknowledged by the author.
